metricDefinitions.complexity: Complexity of the file based on the number of paths through the code. Also includes complexity introduced by definition of functions, classes, etc. (Represents the 'cognitive load' necessary to overlook the whole file)
metricDefinitions.logic_complexity: Complexity of the file based on number of paths through the code, similar to cyclomatic complexity (only counts complexity in code, not complexity introduced by definition of functions, classes, etc.)
metricDefinitions.max_complexity_per_function: The maximum complexity inside the body of a function in this file
metricDefinitions.rloc: Number of lines that contain at least one character which is neither a whitespace nor a tabulation nor part of a comment
metricDefinitions.loc: Lines of code including empty lines and comments
metricDefinitions.comment_lines: The number of comment lines found in a file
